title: Directional Peer Effects in Technology Adoption: Influence of Farmer Interactions in Sustaining Rice Production in Thailand
title_zh: 技术采纳中的定向同伴效应：泰国农民互动对维持水稻生产的影响
title_primary: 技术采纳中的定向同伴效应：泰国农民互动对维持水稻生产的影响
title_secondary: Directional Peer Effects in Technology Adoption: Influence of Farmer Interactions in Sustaining Rice Production in Thailand
authors: Boyeong Park, Taeyoon Kim, Donghwan An, Phumsith Mahasuweerachai
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines whether Sustainable Rice Platform (SRP) practices in Thailand are driven by directional social peer exposure and physical proximity. Analysing survey data from 1363 rice‐producing households across Thailand's Central and Northeastern regions, we construct a directed social network based on self‐reported information exchanges alongside a spatial network grounded in shared subdistrict locations. Methodologically, the analysis transitions from probit specifications to Spatial Durbin Models that jointly account for spatial peer outcomes and covariates. The results show a robust positive association between the adoption behaviour of physically proximate peers and household SRP adoption. By contrast, the average peer effect in the pooled social network is not statistically significant. Once the social network is decomposed by direction, however, a significant positive peer effect emerges for inward ties—relationships from which farmers receive information—while outward ties remain insignificant. Program participation, irrigation access, and prior use of SRP‐related practices are also positively associated with adoption. These findings suggest that sustainable technology diffusion depends not simply on social connectedness, but on the directional flow of information and the visual observability of practices in physical space. By integrating spatial and directed social networks within a unified framework, this study underscores the critical role of directional heterogeneity in peer‐driven agricultural technology adoption.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察泰国可持续水稻平台（SRP）实践是否由方向性社会同伴暴露与物理邻近性所驱动。通过分析来自泰国中部和东北部地区1363个水稻种植户的调查数据，我们构建了一个基于自我报告信息交流的有向社会网络，以及一个基于共同分区位置的空间网络。在方法上，分析从probit设定转向空间杜宾模型，该模型同时考虑空间同伴结果与协变量。结果表明，物理邻近同伴的采纳行为与农户SRP采纳之间存在稳健的正相关关系。相比之下，合并社会网络中的平均同伴效应在统计上不显著。然而，一旦按方向对社会网络进行分解，内向联系——即农户从中接收信息的关——呈现出显著的正向同伴效应，而外向联系仍不显著。项目参与、灌溉可及性以及此前对SRP相关实践的使用也与采纳呈正相关。这些发现表明，可持续技术扩散不仅取决于社会连通性，还取决于信息的方向性流动以及实践在物理空间中的视觉可观察性。通过在统一框架内整合空间网络与有向社会网络，本研究强调了方向性异质性在同伴驱动的农业技术采纳中的关键作用。

title: A Model of Global Firms and Capital Markets
title_zh: 全球企业与资本市场模型
title_primary: 全球企业与资本市场模型
title_secondary: A Model of Global Firms and Capital Markets
authors: Loukas Karabarbounis, Bruno Pellegrino, Juliana Salomao
official: 官方在线 2026-08-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a general-equilibrium model of the global economy that integrates heterogeneous firms competing in product markets with countries that allocate capital around the world. Combining a hedonic demand system on the product side with a mean-variance portfolio system on the asset side, we obtain almost closed-form solutions for the equilibrium of the model. We use firm-level data on balance sheets, geographic breakdowns of revenue and employment, and business descriptions along with country-level data on bilateral equity holdings and trade costs to quantify the model to a cross section of roughly 23,000 listed firms in 48 countries. We use the model to evaluate the reallocation and welfare effects of globalization. Both financial and trade liberalization concentrate activity among the largest firms and raise welfare, with gains being larger in emerging and mid-sized open economies respectively. Product- and capital-market frictions amplify each other, meaning that liberalizing one market reduces the gains from liberalizing the other.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个全球经济的总体均衡模型，该模型将产品市场中竞争的异质性企业与在全球范围内配置资本的国家相结合。通过在产品侧结合享乐需求系统，在资产侧结合均值-方差投资组合系统，我们得到了模型均衡的近似闭式解。我们利用企业层面的资产负债表数据、收入和就业的地理分布、业务描述，以及国家层面的双边股权持有和贸易成本数据，将模型量化应用于48个国家约23,000家上市公司的横截面数据。我们运用该模型评估全球化带来的重新配置和福利效应。金融和贸易自由化均使活动集中于规模最大的企业，并提升福利，其中新兴经济体和中型开放经济体分别获得更大的收益。产品市场和资本市场的摩擦相互放大，意味着对其中一个市场的自由化会减少另一个市场自由化带来的收益。

title: When It Hurts the Most: Timing of Parental Job Loss and a Child’s Education,
title_zh: 父母失业时机与子女教育：最痛之时
title_primary: 父母失业时机与子女教育：最痛之时
title_secondary: When It Hurts the Most: Timing of Parental Job Loss and a Child’s Education,
authors: Paul Bingley, Lorenzo Cappellari, Marco Ovidi
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We estimate how the timing of parental job loss shapes children’s human capital by exploiting plant closures in Danish administrative data. We match treated children to observably similar untreated peers and difference out age-invariant selection using children whose parents are displaced after school completion. Job loss during infancy (ages 0–1) reduces ninth-grade mathematics achievement by 0.04 standard deviations and raises non-completion by one percentage point. Effects are smaller in later childhood. Treated infants are 1.4 percentage points less likely to enrol in general upper-secondary programs. We find that liquidity-constrained families drive these results, suggesting that transient income shocks create permanent educational scars.
abstract_zh: 我们利用丹麦行政数据中的工厂关闭事件，估计了父母失业时机如何影响子女人力资本。我们将受影响的儿童与观察特征相似且未受影响的同龄人进行匹配，并通过父母在子女完成学业后失业的儿童来差分消除年龄不变的筛选效应。婴儿期（0-1岁）父母失业使九年级数学成绩降低0.04个标准差，并使未完成学业的比例上升一个百分点。在儿童后期，影响较小。受影响的婴儿进入普通高中项目的可能性低1.4个百分点。我们发现，流动性受限家庭是这些结果的主要驱动因素，这表明暂时性的收入冲击会留下永久性的教育伤痕。

title: Safer Driving for a Price: Evidence on Behavior and Habits in Kenyan Minibuses
title_zh: 价格更安全的驾驶：肯尼亚小巴行为与习惯的证据
title_primary: 价格更安全的驾驶：肯尼亚小巴行为与习惯的证据
title_secondary: Safer Driving for a Price: Evidence on Behavior and Habits in Kenyan Minibuses
authors: David Schönholzer, Gregory Lane, Erin M. Kelley
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Road traffic injuries are the leading cause of death among people aged 5–29. Where traffic laws are weakly enforced, it is unclear whether road safety interventions can change behavior. We run a randomized controlled trial among 203 Kenyan minibuses, testing whether an incentive scheme improves safety overall or merely shifts unsafe driving to unmonitored times. Drivers reduce speeding by 29 percent and harsh braking by 13 percent, improving a safety index by 0.096 standard deviations. Labor-supply and earnings effects are modest, with little displacement across times or places. Improvements fade quickly, suggesting lasting change requires sustained enforcement or stronger incentives.
abstract_zh: 道路交通伤害是5至29岁人群的首要死因。在交通法规执行不力的地区，道路安全干预措施能否改变行为尚不明确。我们在203辆肯尼亚小巴中开展了一项随机对照试验，检验激励计划是全面改善安全状况，还是仅仅将不安全驾驶行为转移至未受监控的时间段。驾驶员超速行为减少29%，急刹车行为减少13%，安全指数提升0.096个标准差。劳动力供给和收入效应较为温和，且在不同时间或地点间几乎没有转移效应。改善效果迅速消退，表明持久改变需要持续执法或更强激励。

title: Cooking, Health, and Daily Exposure to Pollution Spikes
title_zh: 烹饪、健康与日常污染峰值暴露
title_primary: 烹饪、健康与日常污染峰值暴露
title_secondary: Cooking, Health, and Daily Exposure to Pollution Spikes
authors: Susanna B. Berkouwer, Joshua T. Dean
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Many routine daily activities—such as cooking and commuting—cause large recurring pollution spikes that may impact health without significantly affecting average exposure. We study pollution spikes by combining experimental variation in cooking technology with high-frequency data on individual pollution exposure and time-use in Kenya. Improved cookstoves reduce PM2.5 spikes while cooking by 51.3 μg/m 3 (41 percent) and cause a 0.24 standard deviation reduction in self-reported respiratory symptoms. However, even after more than three years of daily use, we find no clinical health improvements, possibly because we detect no impact on average exposure. Clinical health improvements may require reductions in ambient concentrations. (JEL I12, O12, O13, Q51, Q53)
abstract_zh: 许多日常活动（如烹饪和通勤）会引发频繁且严重的污染峰值，这些峰值可能影响健康，却不会显著改变平均暴露水平。我们通过结合烹饪技术的实验性变化与肯尼亚个体污染暴露及时间利用的高频数据，对污染峰值展开研究。改良炉灶使烹饪期间的PM2.5峰值降低51.3微克/立方米（降幅达41%），并导致自报呼吸道症状减少0.24个标准差。然而，即便经过三年以上的日常使用，我们仍未发现临床健康指标的改善，这可能是因为我们未检测到对平均暴露水平的影响。临床健康的改善或许需要降低环境本底浓度。（JEL I12, O12, O13, Q51, Q53）

title: Cool Cities: The Value of Urban Trees
title_zh: 凉爽城市：城市树木的价值
title_primary: 凉爽城市：城市树木的价值
title_secondary: Cool Cities: The Value of Urban Trees
authors: Han, Lu, Heblich, Stephan, Timmins, Christopher, Zylberberg, Yanos
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: As urban populations grow, more people face extreme heat, increasing demand for natural cooling. Urban trees offer various amenities, including cooling benefits, yet their economic value is hard to quantify. This paper estimates the implicit value of urban trees by exploiting the Emerald Ash Borer infestation caused by an invasive beetle that kills ash trees in Toronto as an exogenous shock. We find that a onepercentage- point increase in a postcode’s tree cover raises property prices by 1.13% and reduces exposure to extreme heat, pollution, and energy consumption. These findings underscore trees as a cost-effective, practical strategy for mitigating urban warming.
abstract_zh: 随着城市人口的增长，越来越多的人面临极端高温，对自然降温的需求也随之增加。城市树木提供了多种便利，包括降温效益，但其经济价值难以量化。本文利用一种入侵性甲虫引发的翡翠灰螟虫害（该虫害导致多伦多的白蜡树死亡）作为外生冲击，估算了城市树木的隐性价值。研究发现，邮政编码区域的树木覆盖率每提高一个百分点，房产价格上升1.13%，同时减少极端高温暴露、污染和能源消耗。这些发现凸显了树木作为缓解城市变暖的经济有效且实用的策略。

title: Intergovernmental Grants to School Districts and Educational Outcomes During the COVID-19 Pandemic
title_zh: 新冠疫情期间政府间对学区的拨款与教育成果
title_primary: 新冠疫情期间政府间对学区的拨款与教育成果
title_secondary: Intergovernmental Grants to School Districts and Educational Outcomes During the COVID-19 Pandemic
authors: Jeffrey Clemens, Philip G. Hoxie, Stan Veuger
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The federal government appropriated $189.5 billion in pandemic aid to school districts through the Elementary and Secondary School Emergency Relief (ESSER) fund. We evaluate their impact on schools with district poverty shares near 5%, where a threshold-driven increase in funds enables us to implement a difference-in-discontinuities design. Federal funds were passed on to residents through reductions in local revenue collections, including property taxes, and did not result in increased per-pupil expenditures by school districts. We find no evidence that additional funds mitigated the declines in test scores. We provide suggestive evidence that political engagement, especially from parents, increased in districts that qualified for additional funds. This combination of engagement and reduced taxation may explain the greater enrollment and faster reopening we observe in such districts.
abstract_zh: 联邦政府通过《中小学紧急救援基金》（ESSER）拨款1895亿美元用于学区疫情援助。我们利用学区贫困率接近5%的门槛效应，通过断点回归设计评估其影响。联邦资金通过减少地方财政收入（包括财产税）转移给居民，并未导致学区生均支出增加。我们未发现额外资金缓解考试成绩下降的证据。初步证据表明，获得额外资金的学区政治参与度（尤其是家长参与）有所提升。这种参与度提高与税收减少的组合效应，或可解释此类学区入学率上升及复课速度加快的现象。

official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Some rural counties remain dependent on agricultural or manufacturing jobs, but an increasing proportion have diversified economics. Rural counties also differ in their abilities to commute to an urban market characterized by higher wages and labor productivity. National changes in immigration and trade policies have had heterogeneous effects on rural labor markets, with counties dependent on agriculture or food processing facing rising input costs and shrinking international output markets. Increased commuting will help some rural communities adapt, while more remote counties will face outmigration, population loss, and reduced capacity to sustain public services.
abstract_zh: 摘要 部分农村县仍依赖农业或制造业就业，但越来越多的农村县实现了经济多元化。农村县在通勤至工资和劳动生产率更高的城市市场的能力上也存在差异。国家移民和贸易政策的变化对农村劳动力市场产生了异质性影响，依赖农业或食品加工的县面临投入成本上升和国际产出市场萎缩的问题。通勤增加将有助于部分农村社区适应变化，而更偏远的县则将面临人口外迁、人口流失以及维持公共服务能力下降的困境。

title: Judicial Gender Match in Juvenile Courts: In-Court Sanctions and Long-Run Socioeconomic Consequences
title_zh: 随机Volterra过程的泛函分部积分公式
title_primary: 随机Volterra过程的泛函分部积分公式
title_secondary: Judicial Gender Match in Juvenile Courts: In-Court Sanctions and Long-Run Socioeconomic Consequences
authors: Eren, Ozkan, Hjalmarsson, Randi, Ozturk, Orgul
official: 官方在线 2026-06-21 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We exploit conditionally random assignment of case files to judges in a Southern U.S. state to study the effects of same-gender judge assignment on juvenile justice decisions and long-run socioeconomic outcomes. Using a generalized differences-in-differences design, we find evidence of same-gender gaps in sentencing decisions: relative to males, female judges are 18% less likely to incarcerate female than male defendants. A novel rank-order test confirms these findings and indicates that the results are not driven by a small subset of judges. Own-gender judicial assignment, especially for Black children, has lasting effects on socioeconomic outcomes beyond the courtroom: educational attainment increases while adult criminal involvement and welfare use decrease. Further analyses suggest that these long-run improvements are not just driven by differential incarceration decisions.
abstract_zh: 人口快速增长、需求激增、干旱、资源供应波动以及供应链中断等危机，日益暴露社会技术系统中隐藏的脆弱性。与此同时，这些危机也为制度和治理创新创造了政治动力和现实紧迫性，因为应急措施往往成为常规实践的雏形。本文为卢旺达构建了一个国家层面的多部门水-能源-排放（W-E-E）情景模型，并利用该模型检验了需求增长、水文压力以及供给侧选择如何共同影响2050年前的能源安全与排放轨迹。分析表明，在SSP2尤其是SSP5增长条件下，排放仍主要由需求驱动；因此，即使是最为雄心勃勃的需求侧和供给侧措施，也最好被理解为减缓而非完全逆转排放增长的路径。本研究的贡献在于识别出哪些效率提升、电气化、可再生能源部署、火电退役以及水文风险管理组合，能在复合危机下最有效地降低系统压力并提升韧性。

title: DP21635 The Commission Paradox: Evidence from Prison Telecommunications
title_zh: 委员会悖论：来自监狱电信的证据
title_primary: 委员会悖论：来自监狱电信的证据
title_secondary: DP21635 The Commission Paradox: Evidence from Prison Telecommunications
authors: Marleen Marra, Nathan Miller, Gretchen Sileo
official: 官方在线 2026-06-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: When an intermediary procures services for end users and receives a commission from the provider, a tension arises: procurement designs that more effectively extract provider rents can simultaneously raise prices and reduce total surplus. We formalize this commission paradox in a first-score auction model and estimate the model using procurement data from the prison telecommunications industry. The paradox emerges empirically, as commissions reduce provider rents but raise call rates. We also find that when commissions enter the scoring rule, increased competition among providers raises payments to the correctional authority but does not lower rates. Banning commissions restores the link between competition and lower rates. Our estimates indicate that recent federal regulations banning commissions and capping rates would lower costs for incarcerated individuals while preserving provider profitability.
abstract_zh: 当中间商为终端用户采购服务并从服务提供商处获取佣金时，便会产生一种矛盾：更有效提取服务提供商租金的采购设计，可能同时推高价格并减少总剩余。我们通过首分拍卖模型对这一佣金悖论进行形式化建模，并利用监狱电信行业的采购数据进行模型估计。实证结果表明该悖论确实存在——佣金虽降低了服务提供商的租金，却推高了通话费率。我们还发现，当佣金被纳入评分规则时，服务提供商之间的竞争加剧虽能提高惩教机构的收入，但并未降低通话费率。禁止佣金制度则能恢复竞争与费率下降之间的关联。估算显示，近期联邦法规禁止佣金并设定费率上限，将在保障服务提供商盈利能力的同时，降低被监禁人员的通话成本。

abstract: Stablecoin transfers are often interpreted as payments. On programmable blockchains, however, they are frequently embedded in atomically executed transaction bundles that combine trading, lending, arbitrage, liquidity provision, and settlement. We show that ignoring this structure materially distorts the interpretation of stablecoin activity. Using 593 million event logs from 141 million Ethereum transactions involving three major U.S. dollar stablecoins, we develop a replicable framework to measure transaction complexity from archive node data, public contract labels, and event signatures.
abstract_zh: 稳定币转账常被解读为支付行为。然而，在可编程区块链上，这些转账往往嵌入在原子化执行的交易包中，这些交易包整合了交易、借贷、套利、流动性提供和结算等功能。我们证明，忽略这一结构会严重扭曲对稳定币活动的解读。通过分析涉及三种主要美元稳定币的1.41亿笔以太坊交易中的5.93亿条事件日志，我们开发了一个可复制的框架，利用归档节点数据、公开合约标签和事件签名来衡量交易复杂性。

title: 改革落实的传导机制：企业感知的视角
title_zh: 改革落实的传导机制：企业感知的视角
title_primary: 改革落实的传导机制：企业感知的视角
authors: 徐现祥, 李粤麟, 陈希路
official: 官方发布 2026-06-10 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 在全面深化改革中,各地落实中央政府提出的改革措施存在明显差异。本文采用2018-2023年连续6年的全国固定点企业访谈数据,从企业感知的视角,考察政府自身改革落实的传导机制。在理论上,本文构建了一个嵌入异质性政府的政务服务市场模型,证明改革落实的传导机制是可感知改革触发要素市场做出一般均衡响应的过程。一个可供检验的推论是,在落实改革措施时,可感知改革将导致资本流动。在经验检验中,本文把“最多跑一次”改革落实视为一个准自然实验,三重差分估计发现,促进资本流动的是可感知改革而非单纯的政府实施改革;可感知改革每增加1%,异地投资流入水平将提高0.67%。这些发现是稳健的,且与本文的理论预期一致,揭示出企业感知在改革落实中的关键作用。

title: Introduction to the special issue on “Institutions in flux: The dynamics of formal and informal rules”
title_zh: 特刊导言：“制度变迁：正式与非正式规则的动态
title_primary: 特刊导言：“制度变迁：正式与非正式规则的动态
title_secondary: Introduction to the special issue on “Institutions in flux: The dynamics of formal and informal rules”
authors: Niclas Berggren
official: 官方在线 2026-06-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This introduction presents the rationale for the special issue “Institutions in flux: The dynamics of formal and informal rules”. It argues that while institutions are central to economic, political and social outcomes, institutional analysis must also explain how rules and norms change, why reforms succeed or fail, and how formal and informal institutions interact. The seven papers in the issue study institutional change across different settings, methods and mechanisms, including reform sequencing, civil society, public-goods provision, censorship, globalization and uncertainty. Together, they show that institutional change is shaped by credibility, coalitions, enforcement, information, culture and power. The special issue therefore contributes to a dynamic understanding of institutions, emphasizing not only their consequences but also their origins, adaptation and unintended effects.
abstract_zh: 本导言阐述了特刊“制度变迁：正式与非正式规则的动态”的设立理由。它指出，尽管制度对经济、政治和社会结果至关重要，制度分析还必须解释规则与规范如何变化、改革为何成功或失败，以及正式与非正式制度如何相互作用。本特刊中的七篇论文研究了不同背景、方法和机制下的制度变迁，包括改革顺序、公民社会、公共品供给、审查制度、全球化和不确定性。它们共同表明，制度变迁受到可信度、联盟、执行、信息、文化和权力的塑造。因此，本特刊有助于对制度的动态理解，不仅强调其后果，还强调其起源、适应及非预期效应。

title: Ethnic bias, commitment and public good provisioning
title_zh: 民族偏见、承诺与公共品供给
title_primary: 民族偏见、承诺与公共品供给
title_secondary: Ethnic bias, commitment and public good provisioning
authors: Sukanta Bhattacharya, T C Shinali
official: 官方在线 2026-06-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In societies where ethnic identity is salient and political institutions are weak, parties often promise ethnicity-specific public goods during elections – promises that voters view with skepticism. These strategies involve a trade-off between mobilizing co-ethnic voters and alienating others. Weak institutions increase the rent from office and lower the cost of reneging on promises. This paper analyzes equilibrium policy outcomes when candidates value both winning and implementing their preferred ethnicity-specific public goods, with deviations from announced platforms being costly. It provides a complete characterization of equilibrium policy implementation across all possible configurations of party ideal platforms. We find that even with low positive costs of non-commitment and office motivation, parties choose to announce their ideal platforms in equilibrium, regardless of bias alignment. This “ideal implementation zone” contracts as non-commitment costs and office motivation increase. When parties have opposing ethnic biases, the zone expands for the majority-biased party and contracts for the minority-biased one as the majority’s size increases. Additionally, we find that the higher provisioning of ethnic public goods is more likely in poorer societies characterized by a large majority group and weak political institutions.
abstract_zh: 在族群认同显著且政治制度薄弱的社会中，政党往往在选举期间承诺针对特定族群的公共产品——而选民对此类承诺持怀疑态度。这些策略涉及在动员同族选民与疏远其他选民之间的权衡。制度薄弱增加了执政的租金，并降低了违背承诺的成本。本文分析了当候选人既重视赢得选举又重视实施其偏好的族群特定公共产品，且偏离已宣布纲领需付出成本时的均衡政策结果。我们提供了在所有可能的政党理想纲领配置下均衡政策实施的完整刻画。研究发现，即使背弃承诺的成本和执政动机较低且为正，政党在均衡中仍会选择宣布其理想纲领，无论偏见方向如何。这一“理想实施区间”随着背弃承诺成本和执政动机的增加而收缩。当政党具有对立的族群偏见时，随着多数群体规模的增大，偏向多数群体的政党的区间扩大，而偏向少数群体的政党的区间缩小。此外，我们发现，在由庞大多数群体和薄弱政治制度所表征的较贫困社会中，族群公共产品供给水平更高的可能性更大。

title: An interest-group theory of AI-tool governance in science
title_zh: 人工智能工具治理的利益集团理论
title_primary: 人工智能工具治理的利益集团理论
title_secondary: An interest-group theory of AI-tool governance in science
authors: Niclas Berggren
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Academic institutions and governance bodies are implementing rules that restrict the use of AI tools in research. This paper develops a formal interest-group theory of AI-tool governance in science, modeling such rules as the endogenous outcome of organized conflict within the scientific community over policies adopted by journals, funders, departments, and professional associations. Scientists differ in how much they gain from AI tools, while rank-relevant rewards, such as publication opportunities, grants, promotions, prizes, and professional recognition, depend partly on relative standing. Even when AI tools raise aggregate knowledge production, scientists with smaller AI-related productivity gains can invest resources to secure restrictions that compress rivals’ rank advantages. The equilibrium likelihood of restriction, lobbying expenditures, and rent dissipation are characterized in closed form in a Tullock contest framework. The model yields a welfare wedge: because rank-based rewards are privately valuable and partly positional, the chosen rules can be excessively restrictive relative to the social optimum. The mechanism is most relevant where governance bodies retain substantial discretion over rule-setting and where scientists cannot easily avoid restrictive policies by shifting to other venues. Restrictions are more likely when disclosure, sanction, or reputational concerns about AI use are more prominent, and when scientists favoring stricter rules are better represented in rule-setting bodies or better able to coordinate pressure for restriction. When scientists’ average net private gain from permissive AI use is positive, restrictions are also more likely when rank incentives are steeper and when AI increases the relative-performance advantage of high-complementarity scientists. The analysis yields testable predictions that distinguish this interest-group account from a public-interest account of AI-tool governance.
abstract_zh: 学术机构和治理主体正在实施限制研究中使用人工智能工具的规定。本文发展了一个关于科学中人工智能工具治理的正式利益集团理论，将这些规则建模为科学界内部围绕期刊、资助机构、院系及专业协会所采纳政策而发生的组织化冲突的内生结果。科学家在从人工智能工具中获益的程度方面存在差异，而与排名相关的奖励，如发表机会、资助、晋升、奖项和专业认可，部分取决于相对地位。即使人工智能工具提高了总体知识生产，那些人工智能相关生产率收益较小的科学家也可能投入资源以争取限制措施，从而压缩竞争对手的排名优势。在塔洛克竞争框架下，限制的均衡概率、游说支出和租金耗散均以闭式解形式刻画。该模型产生了一个福利楔子：由于基于排名的奖励具有私人价值且部分具有地位性，所选择的规则相对于社会最优状态可能过度严格。该机制在治理机构对规则制定保留实质性自由裁量权、且科学家无法通过转向其他场所轻易规避限制性政策的情况下最为相关。当关于人工智能使用的披露、制裁或声誉担忧更为突出，且支持更严格规则的科学家在规则制定机构中代表性更强或更能协调施加限制压力时，限制更可能发生。当科学家对允许使用人工智能的平均净私人收益为正时，若排名激励更为陡峭，且人工智能增加了高互补性科学家的相对绩效优势，限制也更可能发生。该分析产生了可检验的预测，将这一利益集团解释与人工智能工具治理的公共利益解释区分开来。

title: Imperial Japan, civilian control, and democratic reversal
title_zh: 日本帝国、文官统治与民主逆转
title_primary: 日本帝国、文官统治与民主逆转
title_secondary: Imperial Japan, civilian control, and democratic reversal
authors: Jedediah Pida-Reese
official: 官方在线 2026-06-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates why Imperial Japan’s promising Taishō-era democracy (1905–32) experienced a gradual descent into militarism that culminated in the collapse of party government and the effective subordination of civilian authority to the military by the late 1930s. Building on North et al.’s (2009) framework, I argue that this democratic reversal was driven by a failure to consolidate civilian control over the instruments of violence. Facing the existential threat of Russian expansion, civilian elites made a deliberate decision to empower the military at a moment when civilian institutional control over the armed forces was weak and the military technology being adopted concentrated coercive power in a professional officer corps insulated from civilian oversight. This combination produced a substantial probability of eventual military takeover, which was realized over the following three decades as each remaining instrument of civilian authority was tested and broken in turn. This trajectory is contrasted with that of Britain, where civilian institutional control over the military had been consolidated two centuries before industrial warfare arrived. Comparable military technologies were later absorbed there into an existing civilian chain of command and kept under civilian direction. I identify a distinct pathway of democratic backsliding and demonstrate that the strength of civilian institutional control and the character of available military technology at the moment of military empowerment are critical determinants of whether democracy endures.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨为何日本帝国颇具前景的大正时代民主（1905–1932年）逐渐滑向军国主义，最终导致政党政府崩溃，并在1930年代末期使文官权力实质上从属于军方。基于诺斯等人（2009年）的分析框架，本文认为，这一民主倒退的根源在于未能巩固文官对暴力工具的控制。面对俄国扩张的生存威胁，文官精英在文官对军队的制度性控制薄弱、且所采用的军事技术将强制力集中于不受文官监督的职业军官团之际，刻意做出了强化军方的决策。这种组合导致军方最终接管政权的概率显著上升，并在随后的三十年间逐一检验并瓦解了剩余的文官权威工具。本文将此路径与英国进行对比——英国在工业战争到来前两个世纪便已巩固了文官对军队的制度性控制。后来引入的同类军事技术被纳入既有文官指挥体系，并始终处于文官主导之下。本文识别出一条独特的民主倒退路径，并证明：在军事权力被赋予的时刻，文官制度性控制的强度与可用军事技术的特性，是决定民主能否存续的关键因素。

title: Information, Beliefs and Support for Retaliatory Tariffs on US Agricultural Products: Evidence From a Randomised Controlled Trial in China
title_zh: 信息、信念与对美国农产品报复性关税的支持：来自中国随机对照试验的证据
title_primary: 信息、信念与对美国农产品报复性关税的支持：来自中国随机对照试验的证据
title_secondary: Information, Beliefs and Support for Retaliatory Tariffs on US Agricultural Products: Evidence From a Randomised Controlled Trial in China
authors: Guiwang Ling, Xi Tian
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The US–China trade war has profoundly reshaped global agricultural markets, yet the consequences of protectionist measures for domestic public attitudes—particularly within collectivist societies like China—have been underexplored. This study investigates how Chinese citizens perceive retaliatory tariffs on US agricultural products and explores how awareness of economic self‐interest shapes their support for such policies. We develop a simple theoretical model showing that trade policy attitudes are shaped by both social values and economic beliefs, with the influence of new information moderated by trust and cognitive capacity. The model predicts that information interventions can recalibrate beliefs towards actual economic interests, with effects varying by information credibility and individual human capital. Employing a randomised controlled trial in 2023, we demonstrate that backing for trade protection in China is robustly associated with collectivist values. Individuals demonstrate a strong propensity of alignment with government positions over economic self‐interests. However, when people learn about how tariffs will personally affect their household costs, they become less supportive of trade protection because they revise their expectations about economic consequences. Notably, the efficacy of these interventions depends critically on the respondents' trust in information and their level of human capital. Our findings offer new insights into the dynamics of public opinion formation in contexts where information flows are state‐mediated, with direct implications for the design of agricultural and trade policy communication strategies.
abstract_zh: 中美贸易战深刻重塑了全球农产品市场，然而保护主义措施对国内公众态度的影响——尤其是在中国这样的集体主义社会中——尚未得到充分探讨。本研究考察了中国公民如何看待针对美国农产品的报复性关税，并探讨了对经济自身利益的认识如何影响其对这类政策的支持。我们构建了一个简洁的理论模型，表明贸易政策态度既受社会价值观影响，也受经济信念影响，而新信息的影响力则受到信任和认知能力的调节。模型预测，信息干预能够将信念重新校准至实际经济利益方向，其效果因信息可信度和个人人力资本而异。通过2023年开展的随机对照试验，我们证明中国国内对贸易保护的支持与集体主义价值观密切相关。个体表现出强烈的与政府立场保持一致而非追求经济自身利益的倾向。然而，当人们了解到关税将如何直接影响其家庭成本时，他们对贸易保护的支持度会下降，因为他们修正了对经济后果的预期。值得注意的是，这些干预措施的有效性关键取决于受访者对信息的信任程度及其人力资本水平。我们的研究为信息流动受国家中介的背景下公众舆论形成的动态机制提供了新见解，对农业和贸易政策传播策略的设计具有直接启示意义。

title: Essentiality of degree
title_zh: 学位必要性的本质
title_primary: 学位必要性的本质
title_secondary: Essentiality of degree
authors: Haoyu Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-05-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Cooperative game theory has proposed different notions of powerful players. For example, big-boss games (Muto et al. 1988 On Big Boss Games. In: The economic studies quarterly 39.4:303–321")) and clan games (Potters et al. 1989 Clan Games. In: Games and Economic Behavior 1.3:275–293")) are particular cases of veto games (Bahel 2016 On the Core and Bargaining Set of a Veto Game. In: International Journal of Game Theory 45.3:543–566")). The present paper extends these veto games by assuming that there is a given subset of powerful (or essential) players, but only a few (as opposed to all) essential players are required for a coalition to have a positive group value. The resulting games, which are called r -essential games, encompass convex games (Shapley 1971 Cores of Convex Games. In: International Journal of Game Theory 1.1:11–26")) and veto games. We show that r -essential games have a nonempty core. We give a recursive description of the core. Moreover, it is shown that the core and the bargaining set are equivalent for r -essential games. An application to networks is provided. Similar content being viewed by others
abstract_zh: 合作博弈理论提出了多种关于强有力参与者的概念。例如，大老板博弈（Muto等，1988，《论大老板博弈》，载于《经济研究季刊》第39卷第4期，第303-321页）和宗族博弈（Potters等，1989，《宗族博弈》，载于《博弈与经济行为》第1卷第3期，第275-293页）是否决博弈（Bahel，2016，《否决博弈的核心与谈判集》，载于《国际博弈论杂志》第45卷第3期，第543-566页）的特例。本文通过假设存在一个给定的强有力（或关键）参与者子集，但仅需少数（而非全部）关键参与者即可使联盟具有正群体价值，从而扩展了这些否决博弈。由此产生的博弈被称为r-关键博弈，它涵盖了凸博弈（Shapley，1971，《凸博弈的核心》，载于《国际博弈论杂志》第1卷第1期，第11-26页）和否决博弈。我们证明r-关键博弈具有非空核心，并给出了核心的递归描述。此外，研究表明对于r-关键博弈，核心与谈判集是等价的。本文还提供了在网络中的应用。

title: Animosity is for the Audience: How Social Context Shapes Expressions of Political Hostility
title_zh: 敌意是给观众看的：社会情境如何塑造政治敌意的表达
title_primary: 敌意是给观众看的：社会情境如何塑造政治敌意的表达
title_secondary: Animosity is for the Audience: How Social Context Shapes Expressions of Political Hostility
authors: Chloe Ahn, Shengchun Huang, Yphtach Lelkes
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Partisan vitriol has become a defining feature of American politics, evident in survey responses and social media discourse. Conventional wisdom holds that these expressions reflect deeply rooted hostility. Yet they may also function as social signals, reinforcing loyalty and conformity within partisan groups. In this view, animosity is less about entrenched ideological divisions and more about fostering cohesion among co-partisans. We test this proposition in two settings. First, using the 2012 American National Election Studies, which recorded interviewer partisanship, we exploit within-interviewer variation to examine whether respondents adjusted their reported hostility depending on the partisan identity of their interviewer. Respondents expressed significantly more animosity when interviewed by a co-partisan and less when facing an opposing-partisan interviewer. Second, in an online experiment with 1,510 participants, we find that revealing a partner’s partisan alignment—when it matched the participant’s—encouraged more frequent out-group attacks and in-group promotion. These behaviours were strongly shaped by social norms: participants were substantially more likely to attack when their partner had done so in the previous round. Together, these findings suggest that partisan hostility is contingent on immediate social context, not solely on deeply held animus.
abstract_zh: 党派恶语相向已成为美国政治的一个显著特征，在调查反馈和社交媒体讨论中随处可见。传统观点认为，这些言论反映了根深蒂固的敌意。然而，它们也可能发挥社会信号的作用，强化党派内部的忠诚与从众心理。按照这种观点，敌意更多源于促进同党成员间的凝聚力，而非固化的意识形态分歧。我们在两个场景中检验了这一命题。首先，利用记录了访谈者党派归属的2012年美国全国选举研究数据，我们通过分析同一访谈者面对不同受访者时的差异，考察受访者是否会根据访谈者的党派身份调整其表达的敌意程度。结果显示，当受访者面对同党访谈者时，其表达的敌意显著增强；而面对对立党派访谈者时，敌意则明显减弱。其次，在一项包含1510名参与者的在线实验中，我们发现：当参与者得知搭档的党派立场与自己一致时，他们会更频繁地攻击外群体并推崇内群体。这些行为深受社会规范的影响——若搭档在前一轮中发起攻击，参与者发动攻击的可能性会显著提高。综合来看，这些发现表明，党派敌意取决于即时的社会情境，而非仅仅源于根深蒂固的敌视情绪。

title: Buy to Let: The Role of Rental Investors in Housing Booms
title_zh: 购房出租：租赁投资者在住房繁荣中的作用
title_primary: 购房出租：租赁投资者在住房繁荣中的作用
title_secondary: Buy to Let: The Role of Rental Investors in Housing Booms
authors: Erlend Eide Bø

abstract: How do rental investors affect housing price dynamics? I develop a search model that allows housing owners to invest in rental housing. The model matches the high investor share and housing price increase observed in a housing boom in Oslo, Norway, while featuring increasing price-to-rent, and correlation of the buy-to-let share with housing price growth. In the model, an exogenous shock to population inflow increases demand for both owned and rented housing. Increased rental demand induces more buy-to-let investors to enter the market, adding extra demand to the housing market. Search frictions are important to explain an increasing price-to-rent ratio.
abstract_zh: 租赁投资者如何影响房价动态？我构建了一个允许住房所有者投资于租赁住房的搜寻模型。该模型与挪威奥斯陆住房繁荣期间观察到的高投资者占比和房价上涨现象相吻合，同时呈现出房价租金比上升以及购房出租份额与房价增长之间的相关性。在模型中，人口流入的外生冲击增加了对自有住房和租赁住房的需求。租赁需求的增加促使更多购房出租投资者进入市场，为住房市场增添了额外需求。搜寻摩擦对于解释房价租金比上升至关重要。

title: Innovation under censorship: Effects on cultural production in early modern England
title_zh: 审查制度下的创新：对近代早期英格兰文化生产的影响
title_primary: 审查制度下的创新：对近代早期英格兰文化生产的影响
title_secondary: Innovation under censorship: Effects on cultural production in early modern England
authors: Peter Grajzl, Peter Murrell
official: 官方在线 2026-03-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: • In early modern England, censorship permanently boosted cultural innovativeness. • Between 1525 and 1700, English censorship had a chilling effect on quantity, but only temporarily. • English cultural production was especially innovative in Tudor times and the Civil War era. • LLMs contain sufficient information to construct a historical index of censorship. • Cultural innovation and quantity can be measured using machine learning applied to early modern texts. The effects of print censorship on early modern England's cultural production have yet to be examined quantitatively. Doing so requires distilling dispersed qualitative information into numerical data. An annual index of print censorship is constructed by eliciting the historical knowledge encoded in a large language model (LLM) primed with evidence from secondary sources. Application of a machine-learning (ML) algorithm to a major corpus provides document-level measures of cultural innovativeness (quality) and volume (quantity). Pre-existing topic-model estimates apportion each document among distinct cultural themes—three affected by censorship and five unaffected. This yields a yearly theme-level panel for 1525–1700. Local projections estimate censorship's dynamic effects. Counterintuitively, censorship increases innovativeness in censorship-affected themes relative to non-affected themes. Censorship has a temporary chilling effect on the quantity of cultural production though output recovers within a decade. Results are robust to an instrumental-variable approach addressing the endogeneity of censorship. Findings are unchanged when the censorship index is constructed using three alternative LLMs. Leveraging LLMs and ML to measure hard-to-quantify phenomena, such as censorship and cultural production, illuminates the drivers of cultural evolution.

title: Remittance frictions and seasonal poverty
title_zh: 汇款摩擦与季节性贫困
title_primary: 汇款摩擦与季节性贫困
title_secondary: Remittance frictions and seasonal poverty
authors: Ahmed Mushfiq Mobarak, Corey Vernot, Arjun Kharel
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-01-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Seasonal migration is a common strategy to mitigate rural seasonal deprivation, but migrants need to remit money during the lean season to family members facing food shortages. We observe counterintuitively low remittances in rural Nepal during periods of seasonal hunger, and migrants return with remittances later during harvest when food is relatively abundant. To indirectly overcome this apparent constraint in remittance timing, we provide a $90 consumption loan to randomly selected rural households during the pre‐harvest lean season. Loan‐recipient households increase pre‐harvest investments in fertilizer and time spent working on their own farm, smooth consumption, and save more of their migration income to bring it back home. Food security, subjective well‐being, rice harvest, and revenues improve. Ninety‐eight percent of beneficiaries repay the loan with the increased harvest‐period remittance. In a two‐period model of household decision making, we show that remittance frictions—a market failure—are necessary to qualitatively match our experimental results.
abstract_zh: 季节性迁移是缓解农村季节性匮乏的常见策略，但迁移者需在食物短缺的淡季向家人汇款。我们在尼泊尔农村观察到，在季节性饥饿期间汇款额反常偏低，而迁移者往往在收获季节食物相对充裕时才携带汇款返乡。为间接克服这种汇款时间上的明显约束，我们向随机选取的农村家庭在收获前淡季提供90美元消费贷款。获得贷款的家庭增加了淡季的化肥投资和自有农场劳动时间，实现了消费平滑，并将更多迁移收入储蓄后带回。粮食安全、主观幸福感、稻谷收成及收入均得到改善。98%的受益者通过增加收获期汇款偿还贷款。在家庭决策的两期模型中，我们证明汇款摩擦（一种市场失灵）是定性匹配实验结果的关键条件。

title: Golden weapons and golden fetters: From the gold standard to the new geopolitics
title_zh: 黄金武器与黄金枷锁：从金本位到新地缘政治
title_primary: 黄金武器与黄金枷锁：从金本位到新地缘政治
title_secondary: Golden weapons and golden fetters: From the gold standard to the new geopolitics
authors: Harold James
official: 官方在线 2025-10-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper explores the historical relationship between monetary regimes, security concerns, and geopolitical tensions, particularly focusing on the role of gold. Throughout history, monetary systems have been deeply intertwined with international state systems and security provisions. Credibility in monetary regimes is affected by security challenges, often resulting in major systemic restructuring. In the past, military spending and security considerations have often driven debt‐financed expenditure and influenced the choice of monetary policies. After the mid‐twentieth century, as non‐military (socially driven) government expenditure rose, the old considerations faded, but reemerged in the early twenty‐first century. The paper then addresses the weaponization of the dollar and the resurgence of gold as a strategic reserve asset in the face of geopolitical tensions, depolarization efforts, and concerns about asset seizure. The analysis finally investigates how deep‐seated beliefs and historical traumas shape the monetary and geopolitical landscapes.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了货币制度、安全关切与地缘政治紧张之间的历史联系，尤其聚焦于黄金的作用。纵观历史，货币体系与国际国家体系及安全安排紧密交织。货币制度的可信度受到安全挑战的影响，往往导致重大的体系性重组。在过去，军事开支与安全考量常常推动债务融资支出，并影响货币政策的选择。二十世纪中叶以后，随着非军事（社会驱动）政府支出的上升，旧有的考量逐渐淡化，但在二十一世纪初又重新浮现。本文进而讨论了美元武器化现象，以及在地缘政治紧张、去美元化努力和资产没收担忧背景下，黄金作为战略储备资产的复兴。分析最后探讨了深层信念与历史创伤如何塑造货币与地缘政治格局。

title: Public childcare and maternal labour supply in China’s segmented urban labour market
title_zh: 中国分割城市劳动力市场中的公共托育与母亲劳动供给
title_primary: 中国分割城市劳动力市场中的公共托育与母亲劳动供给
title_secondary: Public childcare and maternal labour supply in China’s segmented urban labour market
authors: Zhiming Fu, John Shideler, Zhu Feng
official: 官方在线 2025-09-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper estimates the impact of public childcare on maternal labour supply in China’s segmented urban labour market using data from the China Family Panel Study (2012, 2014, 2016, 2018). Our difference-in-differences analysis shows that public preschool eligibility increases the labour supply for rural-hukou mothers by 30.6% at a 1% significance level, whereas it has no significant effect on their urban-hukou counterparts. To investigate the underlying mechanism behind this heterogeneity, we implement a triple-differences (DDD) strategy. We find that hukou status – reflecting labour market segmentation and associated wage premiums – accounts for a 24.1% higher labour supply response among rural-hukou mothers compared to their urban counterparts, significant at the 5% level. Further controlling for predicted wages renders the DDD estimates statistically insignificant, suggesting that the observed heterogeneity is primarily driven by wage differentials linked to hukou-based labour market segmentation.
abstract_zh: 本文利用中国家庭追踪调查数据（2012、2014、2016、2018年），评估了公共托育对中国城市劳动力市场分割背景下母亲劳动供给的影响。我们的双重差分分析显示，公立学前教育资格使农村户籍母亲的劳动供给增加了30.6%，且在1%的显著性水平上显著，而对城市户籍母亲则无显著影响。为探究这一异质性背后的机制，我们采用了三重差分（DDD）策略。研究发现，户籍状态——反映劳动力市场分割及其相关的工资溢价——解释了农村户籍母亲相较于城市户籍母亲劳动供给反应高出24.1%的现象，且在5%的显著性水平上显著。进一步控制预测工资后，三重差分估计结果变得统计上不显著，表明观察到的异质性主要由与户籍相关的劳动力市场分割所导致的工资差异驱动。
